text:
lara_product: Quick thread to design a "priority sieve" for DP invites so we don't overload ops. Need deterministic rules and a short SLA gate.

devon_cs: Love that. Sieve idea: 1) Integration readiness (PoC or SDK call) 2) Concrete impact metric 3) Compliance red flags 4) Owner availability. Score + rank.

mika_eng: For SLA gate, require expected QPS + target p95 latency and whether they need pinning/quantization. If they ask for <100ms p95 or private env, route to enterprise.

oliver_research: Add a short eval check: 8 prompts we run against their PoC focusing on hallucination + edge cases. Quick pass/fail, not exhaustive.

nina_ops: Ops limit: first wave 6 seats. Also require signed data handling checkbox and preferred deployment window. If partner misses 2 onboarding syncs seat is reclaimed.

lara_product: We should automate the scoring sheet. CS/PM fills intake -> system computes rank. Make one field: "success metric (1-liner)" mandatory.

devon_cs: On calls, use a one-page rubric: Integration (0-5), Impact (0-5), Compliance (0-3), Bandwidth (0-3), Strategic override (0-4). Auto-reject if Integration=0.

mika_eng: Engineering acceptance checklist (minimal): API call OK, rate-limit behavior documented, retry logic tested, sample load test script, monitoring hook (webhook or metrics). If any absent mark as "needs engineering prep".

oliver_research: For feedback signals, capture: weekly API calls, sample prompt quality score (0-4), number of prioritized issues, and partner responsiveness. That's 4 signals.

nina_ops: Also require an expected start week and timezones for sync planning. We'll batch partners by overlap to optimize onboarding slots.

lara_product: Rollback / exit rules? If quality score <2 for 2 consecutive weeks or partner non-response, pause and shift to exploratory. Sales can veto for strategic accounts.

devon_cs: Partner-facing language draft (3 bullets): timeline & time commitment; what we provide (seat, engineering support, eval report); partner asks (PoC, weekly check-ins, sample data). Keep it short.

mika_eng: Can we add a tiny checklist in the intake: "Can you run sample load 1k reqs/day? Y/N". Helps flag infra mismatch earlier.

oliver_research: I'll draft the 8-prompt eval and a 1-paragraph template report.

nina_ops: I'll produce the data handling checkbox + scheduling template and confirm seat count by EOD.

lara_product: OK owners: oliver -> evals, mika -> eng checklist, devon -> CS rubric & intake form, nina -> ops gating. Aim to post drafts in the onboarding repo by tomorrow 10:30am.

eng-bot: reminder: onboarding capacity this sprint: 6 seats. Claim in /intake when ready.

lara_product: Thanks everyone. If anyone needs exceptions for enterprise deals, ping me and include sales contact. We'll iterate on wording after the drafts land.
